hero.h1:
Ka whakaotia e mātou ō raru whakahaere
ki te AI māmā te whakamahi.
hero.sub: Māu e kawe mai ngā raru pakihi, mā mātou ngā rongoā. Mā mātou e whakaaunoa ngā mahi whakahaere, e kimi i te pūmanawa tika, e hanga i tētahi pūnaha māmā.
hero.note: Kore utu, kore reo hangarau. Nō Tāmaki Makaurau, ka mahi puta noa i te motu.

auto.title: Ā mātou mahi
auto.lead: E rua ā mātou āwhina: ko ngā whakaaunoa hei tango i ngā mahi tāruarua, me ngā taputapu matihiko i hangaia mō tō pakihi.
auto.c1d: Ka huri ngā tuhipoka, te karere reo hoki hei tauira whakatau utu. Ka huri ngā mahi kua whakaaetia hei nama, kua rite kia tirohia, kia tukuna.
auto.c2d: Ka tere te whakautu i ngā pātai mō ngā hāora tuwhera, ngā utu me te huarahi i tō paetukutuku me tō īmēra, ā, ka tuhia he whakautu ki ngā arotake Google kia whakaaetia e koe.
auto.c3d: Ka tukuna ake ngā whakaū me ngā whakamahara, kāore he tangata hei whai.
auto.c4t: Te neke raraunga i waenga pūmanawa
auto.c4d: Kaua e tuhi anō i te mahi kotahi ki ngā pūnaha e toru. Ina whakaaetia e ō pūmanawa, ka tukua aunoatia ngā mōhiohio mai i tētahi ki tētahi.
auto.c5d: Hokohoko, taonga, nama kāore anō kia utua, hāora hoki, kotahi te whakarāpopoto ki tō waea ia Rāhina.
auto.c6t: Ngā rekoata ka taea te whakaatu
auto.c6d: Ka whakaritea ngā tuhipoka, whakaaetanga me ngā rīhiti i te wā o te mahi, kua rite ina pātaia.
about.title: Tō Moemoeā Tā Mātou Rongoā
about.p1: Kei ia pakihi iti te wawata o tētahi, te kāwhe e tika ana kia rua, te rōpū e tika ana kia rahi ake. Ehara i te moemoeā te raru, engari ko ngā mahi tāruarua e kai ana i te wiki. Ka hangaia e mātou ngā pūnaha e whakahoki ana i aua hāora, i te reo e mahi pakihi ai koe.
about.a1d: Nāu. Koinei te pūtake o te pakihi.
about.a2d: Ka mātaki mātou i te tino āhua o te mahi.
about.a3d: He whakaaunoa, he taputapu matihiko e hāngai ana ki a koe.
about.a4d: He pūnaha e mahi ana, nāu tonu, me te tangata hei āwhina.
off.g1: Whakaaunoa AI, ka rere te mahi i a ia anō
off.g2: Rongoā matihiko, i hangaia mō tō pakihi

auto.c8d: Aroturuki mahi, whakaahua, nama, whakaaetanga, tō ake taupānga i ia waea.
auto.c9d: Hokohoko, mahi, moni i te tirohanga kotahi — ka whakahou i a ia anō.

kh.lead: He aratohu mārama mō ngā pakihi o Aotearoa: he aha hei whakaaunoa tuatahi, me pēhea e mahi ai, me ngā mea hei tūpato. (Kei te reo Pākehā ngā aratohu)

tf.title: Tirohia te panoni o tō pakihi
tf.lead: Tōia te kakau kia whakakapia ngā puranga pepa me ngā pō roa ki ngā pūnaha e mahi ana i te nuinga o te mahi mōu. Pāwhiria tētahi ira kia kite i te panoni.
tf.hint: Pāwhiria tētahi ira kia kite i te panoni.
priv.b: Ka penapena tēnei paetukutuku i tō reo me tō whiringa tae ki tō pūrere kia kati rā anō te pūtirotiro. Ko ngā kōrero ka tukuna mā te puka whakapā, ka tae mai mā tētahi ratonga puka, ā, ka penapenatia ki tā mātou pūnaha kiritaki kia taea ai te whakautu. Kāore mātou e hoko, e whakamahi rānei mō te whakatairanga ki te kore tō whakaae. Mēnā kāore tātou e mahi tahi, ka mukua ā te 12 marama. He pātai? Waea mai ki +64 22 099 9578.

why.old: Ngā mea ka hē i te nuinga o te wā
why.o1: He wiki te wahangū, kātahi ka tae mai he īmēra
why.o2: Ko taua papa tauira anō, me tō moko kau
why.o3: He kaupapa nui, kāore he mea e kitea mō ngā marama
why.o4: He whakatau utu pōrangi, ka piki i muri i tō haina
why.o5: Ka hoatu ki tētahi kāore koe e kōrero
why.n1: Ka kōrero tōtika koe ki te tangata e hanga ana
why.n2: I hangaia mō te āhua o āu mahi ināianei
why.n3: Kotahi te whakaaunoa i te tuatahi, kia kite, kātahi ka whiriwhiri
why.n4: Ka whakaaetia te whānui me te utu ki te tuhinga i mua i te tīmatanga
why.n5: Ka whakaritea ngā pūnaha ki ō ake pūkete, kia mau tonu ki a koe ahakoa ka mutu tā tātou mahi tahi
terms.b: He kōrero whānui tēnei paetukutuku mō ā mātou ratonga. Ka taea te whakarerekē te ihirangi me te kore pānui, ehara i te whakatau utu, i te tuku, i te kirimana rānei, ka tuhia ā tāua mahi ki tētahi whakaaetanga tuhituhi motuhake. He tauira noa ngā wā me ngā tauira e whakaaturia ana. Ahakoa tā mātou tiaki, kāore e taea te kī kāore he hapa, ā, kāore mātou e whai kawenga mō te mate i puta i te whakawhirinaki ki ēnei kōrero. Ka whai mana te ture o Aotearoa.

how.title: Te huarahi
how.s1t: Ka mātakitaki mātou i te mahi
how.s1d: Ka noho mātou me te tangata e mahi ana i te mahi. Ka waiho e mātou he mahere tuhituhi me te whakatau hāora. Nāu tonu, ahakoa kāore koe e utu i a mātou.
how.s2t: Ka hangaia kotahi te whakaaunoa i te tuatahi
how.s2d: I te nuinga o te wā, kotahi ki te rua wiki, ka whai i te āhua o te mahi. Ka kite koe i te mahi ki ō mahi tūturu, ka whakatairitea ki tō tikanga o nāianei, i mua i te tīmatanga.
how.s3d: Ka hoatu e mātou ngā kupu whakauru, ka whakangungu i tō tīma, ā, mō ngā rā 30 tuatahi ka whakatika, ka whakapai mātou i ngā mea katoa me te kore utu. Mēnā ka mutu tā tātou mahi tahi, ka noho tonu te whakaaunoa ki ō pūkete.
trust.title: He hanga i runga i ō taputapu o nāianei
trust.lead: I te nuinga o te wā, kāore koe e hiahia pūmanawa hou. Ka tīmata mātou ki ngā mea kei tō tēpu me tō waea kē.
trust.u1d: E whakahaerea ana i raro i te Privacy Act 2020. Ko ngā raraunga ka pupuri mātou mōu, ka pupurihia ki Aotearoa, ki Ahitereiria rānei ina taea, ā, ka kōrero mātou ki a koe i te tuatahi mēnā ka pupuri tētahi taputapu i ngā raraunga ki tāwāhi. Ko tā mātou tīma anake e mahi ana ki ō raraunga, ā, ka whakamahia ngā taputapu AI i runga i ngā mahere pakihi kāore e whakangungu i ō raraunga.
trust.u2d: Kotahi te tangata e mōhio ana ki tō pakihi, wātea i ngā hāora o Aotearoa. Kāore he rārangi tiaki.
faq.title: Ngā pātai ka pātaia mai
faq.q1: Ka whakakapi tēnei i aku kaimahi?
faq.a1: Kāore. Ka tangohia ngā mahi tāruarua kia taea e ō tāngata ngā mahi e hiahia ana i te whakaaro, te ringa, te kanohi ora. Ko te whāinga he whakawātea hāora mō ētahi atu mahi, kaua hei whakaiti kaimahi.
faq.q2: Kāore au i te mōhio ki te hangarau.
faq.a2: Kei te pai. Mēnā ka taea e koe te whakaatu me pēhea te mahi i tēnei rā, kua tau. Mā mātou ērā atu, ka whakamārama i te reo māmā.
faq.a3: Ka whakaritea e mātou he mātakitaki ina whakaaetia e ngā taputapu, kia kitea wawetia te nuinga o ngā raru. Mō ngā rā 30 tuatahi i muri i te whakarewanga, he kore utu ngā whakatika me ngā whakapai. I muri i tērā, he mahere ā-marama, he utu ā-mahi rānei, ko tēhea e pai ana ki a koe.
faq.q4: Ka mahi koe i waho o Tāmaki Makaurau?
faq.a4: Āe, puta noa i te motu. Ka mahia te nuinga i tawhiti, ā, ka haere mātou mō te uiui tuatahi ina tika.
faq.a5: Mēnā e neke atu i te toru hāora ia wiki ki te mahi kotahi, he pai te titiro, ahakoa kotahi tō waka, ahakoa e whā tekau ō kaimahi.

ed.chat.qa.app.q: Ka hangaia e koutou he taupānga, he tomokanga rānei?
ed.chat.qa.app.a: Āe: he tomokanga mō ngā kaimahi me ngā kiritaki. Te aroturuki mahi, ngā whakaahua, ngā nama me ngā whakaaetanga, i tō ake taupānga i ia waea. Ka kite ia tangata i ngā mea e hiahiatia ana e ia anake, me tō waitohu, ō tae me tētahi takiuru haumaru, ā, ka tāutahia ki te mata kāinga pērā i tētahi taupānga noa.
ed.chat.qa.book.q: Me pēhea au e tono ai i tētahi wā kore utu?
ed.chat.qa.book.a: Tonoa he wā kore utu, ā, ka tirohia e mātou te āhua tūturu o tō mahi. Ka puta koe me tētahi mahere tuhituhi me tētahi whakatau tata o ngā hāora, māu tonu. Kāore he utu, kāore he kupu hangarau uaua.
ed.chat.qa.data.a: Ka noho tonu ō raraunga hei taonga māu. Ka tiakina e mātou i raro i te Ture Matatapu 2020, ka penapenatia ngā mea e puritia ana e mātou mōu ki Aotearoa, ki Ahitereiria rānei, ā, kore rawa e whakamahia hei whakaako i te tauira AI a tētahi atu.
ed.chat.qa.how.a: E toru ngā hīkoi. Ka mātakitaki mātou i te mahi, ā, ka waiho he mahere tuhituhi me tētahi whakatau tata o ngā hāora mōu, māu tonu. Ka hangaia e mātou kotahi te whakaaunoatanga i te tuatahi, i te nuinga o te wā i roto i te kotahi ki te rua wiki, ā, ka kite koe e mahi ana i ō mahi tūturu. Kātahi ka riro māu: ka tukuna e mātou ngā takiuru, ka whakangungua tō tīma, ā, ka whakatikahia, ka whakarerekēhia noatia ngā mea katoa mō ngā rā 30 tuatahi.
ed.chat.qa.own.q: Nōku anō ngā mea ka hangaia e koutou?
ed.chat.qa.own.a: Āe. Ka whakaritea ngā pūnaha ki ō ake pūkete, nō reira ka mau tonu i a koe ki te mutu tō mahi tahi ki a mātou. Ka tukuna e mātou ngā takiuru, ā, ka whakangungua tō tīma.
ed.chat.qa.price.a: Ka whakawhirinaki ki te mahi me ngā taputapu ka whakamahia, nō reira kāore mātou e whakaputa i tētahi rārangi utu. He kore utu te wā tuatahi. Muri iho ka whiwhi koe i tētahi mahere tuhituhi, ā, ka whakaaetia ā-tuhi te whānuitanga me te utu i mua i te tīmatanga o ngā mahi. Mō ngā rā 30 tuatahi i muri i te whakarewatanga, he kore utu ngā whakatikatika me ngā whakarerekētanga.
ed.chat.qa.time.a: Ka tīmata mātou ki tētahi whakaaunoatanga kotahi, i te nuinga o te wā ka oti i roto i te kotahi ki te rua wiki, kei te āhua o te mahi. Ka kite koe e mahi ana i ō mahi tūturu, ka āta tirohia ki te taha o tō tikanga o nāianei, i mua i tōna whakarewatanga.
ed.chat.qa.web.q: Ka taea e koutou te hanga paetukutuku mōku?
ed.chat.qa.web.a: Āe. Ka hangaia e mātou he paetukutuku tere, reo maha hoki, e whakawhiwhi ana i te whakapono, e huri ana i ngā manuhiri hei waea mai. He māmā ki a koe te whakahou, kāore he kaiwhakawhanake e hiahiatia, kua whakaritea kia mārama a Google ki āu ratonga, ā, ka tae tika atu ngā puka pātai ki tō pouaka īmēra.
ed.chat.qa.what.q: He aha ngā mahi ka taea e koutou te whakaaunoa?
ed.chat.qa.what.a: E rua ngā huarahi e āwhina ai mātou. Ngā whakaaunoatanga e whakakore ana i ngā mahi tāruarua: ngā tātai utu me ngā nama, ngā whakautu ki ngā kiritaki, ngā tono me ngā whakamaumahara, te neke raraunga i waenga i ngā taupānga, ō tatau ia wiki, me ngā pūkete ka taea te whakaatu. Me ngā taputapu matihiko i hangaia mō tō pakihi: ngā paetukutuku e whakawhiwhi ana i te whakapono, ngā tomokanga mō ngā kaimahi me ngā kiritaki, me ngā papatohu ora.
ed.chat.qa.where.a: Kei Tāmaki Makaurau mātou, ā, ka mahi puta noa i Aotearoa. Ko te nuinga o te mahi ka mahia mamao, ā, ka haere mātou mō te haerenga tirotiro tuatahi ina whai hua.

ed.chat.talk.quality: Anei ngā mea ka taea e koe te tūmanako ina mahi tahi koe ki a mātou, i tō mātou ake tikanga mahi:
ed.chat.talk.quality_end: Ko te huarahi māmā rawa ki te aromatawai i a mātou ko te wā kore utu: ka tirohia e mātou te āhua tūturu o tō mahi, ā, ka noho te mahere tuhituhi māu, ahakoa kāore koe e utu i a mātou.
ed.chat.label.listening: E whakarongo ana… kōrero mai ināianei
ed.chat.label.mic_blocked: Hei kōrero i tō pātai, tukua te hopuoro i tō pūtirotiro, tuhia rānei.
ed.chat.greeting: Kia ora! Ko Ambs Bot ahau, te kaiāwhina o Ambs Solutions. Ka taea e au te whakautu i ō pātai mō ā mātou ratonga, ngā utu, te āhua o tā mātou mahi me te tono i tētahi wā kore utu. He aha taku āwhina ki a koe i tēnei rā?
ed.chat.not_found: Kāore au i kite i tētahi whakautu tōtika mō tēnā i tā mātou paetukutuku. Ka taea e tā mātou tīma te whakautu tika: tonoa he wā kore utu, waiho mai tō pātai, whakapā mai rānei ki a mātou.
ed.chat.nudge: Kia ora! Ko Ambs Bot ahau, ā, ka taea e au te whakautu i ō pātai mō te whakaaunoa, ngā paetukutuku, ngā utu me tō mātou wā kore utu. He āwhina ka taea e au?
ed.chat.sugg.3: He aha ka puta i te wā kore utu?
ed.chat.sugg.4: Ko ēhea pūmanawa e mahi ana koutou?
ed.chat.sugg.5: Ka mahi koutou i waho o Tāmaki Makaurau?
ed.chat.talk.offtopic: Kei waho tēnā i ngā mea ka taea e au te āwhina. Kei konei au mō ngā pātai mō Ambs Solutions: ā mātou ratonga, ngā utu, te tukanga me ngā wā kore utu. Mēnā e pā ana ki tō pakihi, ka koa tā mātou tīma ki te āwhina:
ed.chat.talk.who: Ko Ambs Bot ahau, te kaiāwhina o Ambs Solutions. E mōhio ana au ki ā mātou ratonga, ngā utu, te tukanga me ngā ahumahi e mahi tahi ana mātou, ā, kei konei au i ngā wā katoa. Mō ngā pātai kāore e taea e au te whakautu, ka koa tētahi tangata o tā mātou tīma ki te āwhina.
ed.chat.talk.human: Ko Ambs Bot ahau, he kaiāwhina aunoa, ehara i te tangata. Mēnā e hiahia ana koe ki te kōrero ki tā mātou tīma, tonoa he wā kore utu, waiho he karere, waea mai rānei.
ed.chat.talk.help: Ka taea e au te āwhina mō ā mātou ratonga, ngā utu, te āhua o tā mātou mahi, ngā pūmanawa e hono ana mātou, tō ahumahi me te tono i tētahi wā kore utu. Pātaihia mai he aha te aha, pāwhiria rānei tētahi o ēnei hei tīmatanga.
ed.chat.talk.test: Kei konei au, ā, kei te pai taku mahi. Pātaihia mai he aha te aha mō Ambs Solutions.
ed.chat.label.title: Ambs Bot
ed.chat.qa.free.q: He aha ka puta i te wā kore utu?
ed.chat.qa.free.a: Ka noho mātou ki te taha o te tangata e mahi ana i te mahi, ā, ka titiro ki te āhua o te mahi i tēnei rā. Ka whiwhi koe i tētahi mahere tuhituhi me tētahi whakatau tata o ngā hāora, nāu tonu, ahakoa kāore koe e utu i a mātou. Kāore he utu, kāore he reo hangarau, ā, ka taea ki tō wāhi, mamao rānei.
ed.chat.qa.tools.q: Ko ēhea pūmanawa e mahi ana koutou?
ed.chat.qa.tools.a: Ko te nuinga o ngā whakaaunoatanga ka hono i ngā taputapu e utua kētia ana e koe: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, OneDrive me SharePoint), Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sheets me Drive) me Xero. Mēnā ka taea e tō pūmanawa tono, hoko, mahi rānei te kaweake ki Excel, Google Sheets rānei, ka tuku īmēra mai rānei ki a koe, ka mahi mātou mai i tērā. I te nuinga o te wā kāore koe e hiahia ki tētahi pūmanawa hou.
ed.chat.qa.support.q: He aha te tautoko i muri i te whakarewanga?
ed.chat.qa.support.a: Ka whakaritea e mātou he aroturuki ki ngā wāhi e āhei ai ngā taputapu, kia kitea wawetia te nuinga o ngā raruraru. He kore utu ngā whakatika me ngā whakarerekē mō ngā rā 30 tuatahi i muri i te whakarewanga. Muri iho, ko te tautoko he mahere ā-marama, he utu ā-mahi rānei, ko tērā e pai ana ki a koe, me tētahi kaiwhakapā kua tapaina e wātea ana i ngā hāora o Aotearoa.
ed.chat.qa.team.q: Ko wai ka mahi tahi ki a au?
ed.chat.qa.team.a: Ka mahi tōtika koe ki te tangata nāna i hanga: kotahi te kaiwhakapā kua tapaina e mōhio ana ki tō pakihi, e wātea ana i ngā hāora o Aotearoa. Kāore he rārangi tīkiti, kāore he tukutuku ki ētahi atu.
ed.chat.qa.team.ll: He aha ai me mahi tahi ki a mātou
ed.chat.qa.industries.q: Ko ēhea ahumahi e mahi tahi ana koutou?
ed.chat.qa.industries.a: Ka mahi tahi mātou ki ngā pakihi iti, ki ngā pakihi e tipu ana o Aotearoa, tae atu ki ngā wharekai me ngā toa kai tango, ngā kaimahi hangahanga, ngā whare haumanu me ngā whare whakapaipai, ngā toa me ngā toa iti, ngā kaitohutohu me ngā kaikaute, me ngā kamupene kawe me te tuku. Mēnā kāore tō pakihi i tēnei rārangi, ka tīmata mātou ki ngā mahi tāruarua e mahia ana e koe ia wiki.
ed.chat.qa.size.a: Mēnā he nui ake i te toru hāora ia wiki e whakapaua ana e koe ki te mahi kotahi, he pai te titiro, ahakoa kotahi tō wāka, e whā tekau rānei ō kaimahi. E nui te manako ki ngā kaipakihi takitahi.
ed.chat.qa.ai.a: Ko tōna tikanga, ko ngā mahi e mahia ana e tō tīma i te āhua kotahi ia wiki, pērā i ngā tātai utu, ngā whakamaumahara, te patopato anō me ngā pūrongo, ka hangaia he pūnaha hei mahi mōu. Kei a koe tonu te kupu whakamutunga: ko ngā mea e pā ana ki te moni, ki ngā amuamu, ki te whakatau rānei, ka taea te tuku ki a koe kia tirohia i te tuatahi.
ed.chat.qa.training.q: Ka whakangungu koutou i taku tīma?
ed.chat.qa.training.a: Āe. Ina whakarewaina tētahi whakaaunoatanga, ka tukuna e mātou ngā takiuru, ā, ka whakangungua tō tīma ki te whakamahi, i te reo māmā. Ka taea te whakangungu i te reo Pākehā, i te reo Hindi, i te reo Punjabi rānei, ko tā tō tīma e pai ai.
ed.chat.label.subtitle: Kaiāwhina o Ambs Solutions
ed.chat.label.langs_line: Ka kōrero hoki au i te {langs}. Tuhia mai i tō reo, pāwhiria rānei tētahi i raro nei.
ed.chat.qa.noshow.q: Ka taea e koutou te whakaiti i te hunga kāore e tae mai?
ed.chat.qa.noshow.a: Āe. Ka whakaritea e mātou ngā karere whakaū, whakamaumahara, tono anō hoki e whakaiti ana i te hunga kāore e tae mai, kāore he tangata e whai haere. Ka mahi tahi ki te pūnaha tono kei a koe kē, ka taea te tuku i ngā wāhi kua whakakorea ki te hunga kei te rārangi tatari, ā, ka taea e tētahi karere whai muri i te toronga te tono arotake.
ed.chat.qa.noshow.ll: Me pēhea te whakaiti i te hunga kāore e tae mai
ed.chat.talk.knowledge: Āe. E mōhio pai ana au ki a Ambs Solutions: ā mātou ratonga, ngā utu, te āhua o tā mātou mahi, ngā pūmanawa e hono ana mātou, ngā ahumahi e mahi tahi ana mātou, ngā raraunga me te tūmataiti, me ngā aratohu i tā mātou paetukutuku. Pātaihia mai he aha te aha, pāwhiria rānei tētahi o ēnei hei tīmatanga.
ed.chat.qa.invoices.q: Ka taea e koutou te whakaaunoa i ngā tātai utu me ngā nama?
ed.chat.qa.invoices.a: Āe. Ko ngā tuhipoka mai i te wāhi mahi, he karere reo rānei, ka huri hei tātai utu hukihuki i ō ake utu me ō kupu, ā, ko ngā mahi kua whakaaetia ka huri hei nama kua rite ki te tirotiro me te tuku. Ka tae atu ngā nama ki tō taupānga kaute, kāore he patopato anō, ā, ka tukuna ngā whakamaumahara utu ngākau pai i te wā tika.
ed.chat.qa.invoices.ll: Me pēhea te whakaaunoa i ngā tātai utu me ngā nama
ed.chat.qa.tax.q: Ka taea e koutou aku tāke, aku kaute rānei?
ed.chat.qa.tax.a: Kāo, kāore mātou e mahi i ngā whakahoki tāke, e tuku tohutohu tāke rānei. Nā tō kaikaute tēnā mahi. Ko tā mātou e taea ai, he whakanahanaha i ngā rekoata kei muri: ka haere tōtika ngā nama ki Xero, ka kōnaetia ngā rihīti i te wā e mahia ana te mahi, ā, ka puritia ngā rekoata wahie me te mareaka mōu, kia māmā ake te tuku atu.
ed.chat.qa.app.also: taupānga, taupānga waea, tomokanga, kaimahi, kiritaki, takiuru
ed.chat.qa.dashboards.a: Āe. Ka whakaatu tētahi papatohu ora i ngā hokonga, ngā mahi me te moni i te tirohanga kotahi e whakahou ana i a ia anō, ahakoa kei hea koe. Ka hangaia ki ngā tau e aro nui ana koe, ka whakamōhio atu ina neke tētahi tau ki waho o tōna awhe noa, ā, he māmā te tiri ki tō tīma, ki tō kaikaute rānei.
ed.chat.qa.dashboards.ll: Ngā paetukutuku, ngā tomokanga me ngā papatohu
ed.chat.qa.replies.q: Ka taea e koutou te āwhina ki ngā whakautu kiritaki me ngā arotake Google?
ed.chat.qa.replies.a: Āe. Ka whakautua wawetia ngā pātai mō ngā hāora tuwhera, ngā utu me ngā aronga i tō paetukutuku, mā te īmēra hoki, ā, ka tuhia hukihukitia ngā whakautu ki ngā arotake Google i tō ake reo, hei whakaae māu. Ka whakamōhiotia tonutia koe ki ngā karere hohoro.

ed.chat.qa.web_price.a: Ka whakawhirinaki ki ngā whārangi, ngā reo me ngā āhuatanga e hiahiatia ana e koe, nō reira kāore mātou e whakaputa i tētahi rārangi utu paetukutuku. Muri i te wā kore utu ka whiwhi koe i tētahi mahere tuhituhi, ā, ka whakaaetia te hōkaitanga me te utu ki te tuhituhi i mua i te tīmatanga o ngā mahi.
ed.chat.qa.web_price.also: utu paetukutuku, he aha te utu o te paetukutuku, utu pae
ed.chat.qa.value.a: Ka whakawhirinaki ki te mahi. Hei tikanga noa, ko tētahi mahi e toru hāora, nui ake rānei i ia wiki, i ia wiki, he mea tika kia tirohia. I te wā kore utu ka inea e mātou tō ake wiki, ka waiho hoki he whakatau tata hāora, kia taea ai e koe te whakataurite i te utu ki te wā ka penapenatia i mua i tō whakapau moni.
ed.chat.qa.pay.a: Ka whakawhirinaki ki te mahi. Ka whakaaetia ngā tikanga utu ki te tuhituhi, me te hōkaitanga me te utu, i mua i te tīmatanga o ngā mahi, kia mōhio ai koe he aha tāu e utu ai, āhea hoki. Ka taea e tō mātou tīma te whakamārama i ngā kōwhiringa i tō wā kore utu.
ed.chat.qa.pay.also: utu, utu tōmua, utu wāhanga, pēke, kāri nama
ed.chat.qa.contract.q: Me haina e au he kirimana roa?
ed.chat.qa.contract.also: kirimana, kirimana roa, whakakore, whakaaetanga, wehe
ed.chat.qa.works.q: Ki te kore e whai hua?
ed.chat.qa.works.a: Ehara ā mātou whakatau tata hāora i te kī taurangi, engari kāore koe e whakawhirinaki noa ki aua kōrero. Ka hangaia e mātou tētahi whakaaunoatanga tuatahi, ā, ka kite koe i a ia e mahi ana i ō mahi tūturu, ka āta tirohia ki te taha o tō tikanga o nāianei, i mua i tō whakawhirinaki atu. He kore utu ngā whakatika me ngā whakapai mō ngā rā 30 tuatahi i muri i te whakarewatanga, ā, ka whakatūria e mātou he aroturuki ki ngā wāhi e āhei ai ngā taputapu, kia kitea wawetia te nuinga o ngā raruraru. Mō ētahi atu take, pērā i te whakahoki moni, mā tō mātou tīma e whakautu tōtika atu ki a koe.
ed.chat.qa.works.also: kāore e whai hua, kī taurangi, whakahoki moni, kāore i te koa
ed.chat.qa.hosting.q: Ka tiaki koutou i te manaaki pae me ngā ingoa rohe?
ed.chat.qa.hosting.also: manaaki pae, ingoa rohe, rēhita ingoa rohe
ed.chat.qa.edit.q: Ka taea e au te whakatika i tōku paetukutuku anō?
ed.chat.qa.edit.a: Āe. He māmā noa te whakahou i ā mātou paetukutuku, kāore e hiahiatia he kaiwhakawhanake. Ki ngā wāhi e āhei ai ngā taputapu, ka whakaritea e mātou kia taea e koe ngā panonitanga māmā, pērā i te whakatika kupu, te tāpiri kaimahi rānei.
ed.chat.qa.edit.also: whakatika anō, whakahou paetukutuku, panoni kupu
ed.chat.qa.inperson.a: Āe, ina whai hua. Ka taea te wā kore utu ki tō wāhi, mamao rānei. Ko te nuinga o ngā mahi ka mahia mamao, ā, ka haere mātou mō te hīkoi tirotiro tuatahi ina whai tikanga te tae ā-tinana.
ed.chat.qa.inperson.also: ā-kanohi, tūtaki, haere mai, mamao, ipurangi
ed.chat.qa.hours.q: Āhea au whakapā atu ai ki a koutou?
ed.chat.qa.hours.a: Ka taea te whakapā mai i ngā hāora o Aotearoa, ā, ka mahi koe me tētahi tangata kotahi e mōhio ana ki tō pakihi, kāore he rārangi tīkiti. Ka taea e koe te waiho karere ki konei i ngā wā katoa.
ed.chat.qa.examples.q: Ka taea e au te kite i ētahi tauira o ā koutou mahi?
ed.chat.qa.examples.a: Ko tēnei paetukutuku tētahi: kei ngā reo e rima, ā, nā mātou anō tēnei kaiāwhina kōrero i hanga. Kei ia whārangi ratonga, ahumahi hoki tētahi tauira noa o te mahi a tētahi whakaaunoatanga. Pātai ki tō mātou tīma mō ngā tauira e tata ana ki tō pakihi.
ed.chat.qa.about.q: Ko wai kei muri i a Ambs Solutions?
ed.chat.qa.chatbot.q: Ka taea e koutou te tāpiri i tētahi karetao kōrero pēnei ki tōku paetukutuku?
ed.chat.qa.chatbot.a: Āe. Nā mātou tēnei kaiāwhina kōrero i hanga. Ka whakautu ia i ngā pātai a ngā manuhiri mai i tō ake paetukutuku, i tō rātou reo, ā, ka tuku i te tono, i te karere rānei ina kāore he whakautu. Ka taea e tō mātou tīma te kōrero mō tētahi mō tō pae.
ed.chat.qa.chatbot.also: karetao kōrero, kaiāwhina kōrero, kōrero ipurangi
ed.chat.qa.staff.q: Ka whakakapia ōku kaimahi e tēnei?
ed.chat.qa.staff.a: Kāo. Ka whakawātea i ngā mahi tōaruaru kia taea e ō tāngata ngā wāhanga e hiahiatia ai te whakaaro, te ringa, te kanohi ataahua rānei. Ko te whāinga he whakawātea hāora mō ētahi atu mahi, kaua ko te tapahi kaimahi.
ed.chat.qa.staff.also: whakakapi kaimahi, tapahi kaimahi, ngaro mahi
ed.chat.qa.techy.q: Me mōhio au ki te hangarau?
ed.chat.qa.techy.a: Kāo. Mēnā ka taea e koe te whakaatu mai me pēhea te mahi i ēnei rā, koia anake e hiahiatia ana. Mā mātou te toenga, ka whakamārama i ngā kupu māmā, kāore he kupu hangarau, ā, ka whakangungu i tō tīma ina whakarewaina.
ed.chat.qa.techy.also: kāore i te mōhio ki te hangarau, rorohiko
ed.chat.qa.software.q: Me hoko au he pūmanawa hou?
ed.chat.qa.software.a: I te nuinga o te wā, kāo. Ko te nuinga o ngā whakaaunoatanga ka hono i ngā taputapu e utua kētia ana e koe, ā, ka hanga mātou i runga i te āhua o tō pakihi i nāianei.
ed.chat.qa.software.also: hoko pūmanawa, pūmanawa hou, rorohiko hou
ed.chat.qa.shop_online.q: Ka hanga koutou i ngā toa ipurangi?
ed.chat.qa.shop_online.a: Kāore ngā toa ipurangi i te kōrerotia i tō mātou paetukutuku, nō reira pātai atu ki tō mātou tīma mō tōu. Ko tā mātou mahi mō ngā toa ko ngā mahi whakahaere i muri: te tatau taonga me te tono anō, te whakahou utu me ngā rārangi, me te whakarāpopototanga hoko o ia rā.
ed.chat.qa.shop_online.also: toa ipurangi, hoko ipurangi, Shopify, utu ipurangi
ed.chat.qa.shop_online.ll: Ngā toa me ngā toa iti
ed.chat.qa.rosters.q: Ka taea e koutou te āwhina ki ngā rārangi mahi me ngā pepa hāora?
ed.chat.qa.rosters.a: Āe. Ka taea e tētahi tomokanga kaimahi te whakaatu i te rārangi mahi, ngā hīkoi whakatuwhera, katinga hoki, me ngā tukunga o te rā, ā, ka taea te tāpiri i ngā pepa hāora mai i te rārangi mahi kia rite mō te utu kaimahi. He maha ngā wharekawhe e whakahaere ana i tō rātou rārangi mahi i tētahi ripanga, ā, ka taea e mātou te mahi ki tērā.
ed.chat.qa.rosters.also: rārangi mahi, pepa hāora, utu kaimahi, hāora kaimahi
ed.chat.qa.rosters.ll: Ngā wharekawhe me ngā toa kai
ed.chat.qa.stock.q: Ka taea e koutou te āwhina ki ngā taonga me te tono anō?
ed.chat.qa.stock.a: Āe. Ia ata ka taea e koe te whiwhi i ngā hoko o inanahi me tētahi tirohanga ā-wiki o ngā taonga e heke haere ana, kia tonoa anōtia i mua i te wāteatanga o te papa. Ka tae atu ngā tono kua tūtohutia ki a koe hei whakaae tuatahi. Ka mahi mātou mai i ngā kaweake a tō pūnaha hoko, pūnaha taonga rānei ki Excel, ki Google Sheets rānei, kaua e hono tōtika atu.
ed.chat.qa.stock.also: taonga, tatau taonga, tono anō, kua iti ngā taonga
ed.chat.qa.stock.ll: Ngā toa me ngā toa iti
ed.chat.qa.book.also: tono, hui, wā kore utu, waea, tīmata, kōrero ki tētahi
ed.chat.qa.data.also: matatapu, raraunga, haumaru, ture matatapu, penapena
ed.chat.qa.free.also: wā kore utu, hui tuatahi, aromatawai, te hīkoi tuatahi
ed.chat.qa.support.also: tautoko, tiaki, i muri i te whakarewanga, aroturuki, whakatika, mahere ā-marama
ed.chat.qa.team.also: kaiwhakapā, tīma, kaihanga, ko wai, hāora o Aotearoa
ed.chat.qa.ai.also: AI, atamai hangahanga, whakaaunoa, te tikanga, ChatGPT, whakamārama
ed.chat.qa.value.also: he tika te utu, he utu iti ake, whai hua
ed.chat.qa.contract.a: Ka whakawhirinaki ki te mahi. Ka tīmata ngā mahi i muri anake i tā tāua haina i tētahi whakaaetanga tuhituhi e whakatakoto ana i te hōkaitanga, te utu me ngā wā. Muri i te whakarewatanga, he mahere ā-marama, he utu-ā-mahi rānei te tautoko, ā, ka whakatūria ō pūnaha ki ō ake pūkete, nō reira ka mau tonu i a koe ahakoa ka mutu tō mahi tahi ki a mātou.
ed.chat.qa.hosting.a: Ka whakawhirinaki ki tō pae: ka taea e tō mātou tīma te kōrero mō te manaaki pae me ngā ingoa rohe i te wā kore utu. Ka whakatūria tō paetukutuku me ōna pūkete ki tō ake ingoa, nō reira ka mau tonu i a koe ahakoa ka mutu tō mahi tahi ki a mātou.
ed.chat.qa.hours.also: ngā hāora, wiki whakamutunga, he aha te tere o te whakautu
ed.chat.qa.examples.also: tauira, ngā mahi o mua, ngā kiritaki
ed.chat.qa.about.a: He tīma iti nō Tāmaki Makaurau a Ambs Solutions e āwhina ana i ngā pakihi iti, whanake hoki o Aotearoa ki te whakaaunoa, ki ngā paetukutuku me ngā tomokanga. Ka mahi tōtika koe me ngā tāngata nā rātou i hanga: kotahi te tangata whakapā e mōhio ana ki tō pakihi. Ko tō mātou ake tīma anake e mahi ana ki ō raraunga.
ed.chat.qa.about.also: mō koutou, kamupene, nā wai, kaiwhakarewa, te rahi o te tīma
ed.chat.qa.marketing.q: Ka whakahaere koutou i ngā pānui hokohoko, i te pāpāho pāpori rānei?
ed.chat.qa.marketing.also: pānui hokohoko, pāpāho pāpori, Google Ads, Facebook, Instagram, hokohoko
ed.chat.qa.overseas.q: Ka mahi koutou me ngā pakihi i waho o Aotearoa?
ed.chat.qa.overseas.a: Āe. Ka mahi mātou me ngā pakihi i ngā wāhi katoa, ko te nuinga mamao. Kei Tāmaki Makaurau tō mātou tīma, ā, ka mahi i ngā hāora o Aotearoa.
ed.chat.qa.overseas.also: Ahitereiria, tāwāhi, i waho o Aotearoa, whenua kē
ed.chat.qa.nda.q: Ka haina koutou i tētahi whakaaetanga muna?
ed.chat.qa.nda.a: Kei roto te noho muna i te whakaaetanga tuhituhi ka hainatia e tāua i mua i te tīmatanga o ngā mahi, ā, ko tō mātou ake tīma anake e mahi ana ki ō pārongo.
ed.chat.qa.marketing.a: Mā tētahi hoa mahi anake. Kāore mātou e whakahaere ake i ngā pānui hokohoko, i te pāpāho pāpori rānei, engari ka taea e mātou te whakarite i ngā pānui Google, Facebook, Instagram rānei, i te whakahaere pāpāho pāpori rānei mā tētahi hoa mahi, i te taha o te paetukutuku me ngā whakaaunoatanga ka hangaia e mātou. Pātai mai i tō wā kore utu.
ed.chat.qa.what.also: he aha tā koutou mahi, ratonga, whakaaunoa, tauira
